title: potentilla kinabaluensis
intro: Potentilla kinabaluensis, commonly known as the Kinabalu Potentilla, is a rare plant species native to the mountainous regions of Borneo. It is a member of the rose family (Rosaceae) and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla kinabaluensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
